description:
Chat with your Shopify or WooCommerce sales data directly in ChatGPT. Ask questions like "Where do our most profitable customers come from?" or "Which products are trending this quarter?" and get real-time answers pulled straight from your store.

Dig into revenue, products, customers, and channels, or ask for a growth strategy built on your actual historical data. Works with one store or many, with every metric generated in real-time.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my store’s performance this month, compare it with last month, and explain the biggest changes
Compare sales across all my stores over the past month and which channel is sending the most orders
Show which products and categories generated the most revenue this quarter
